name: What is a tub-to-shower conversion?

acceptedAnswer.text: A tub-to-shower conversion transforms an existing bathtub and shower combination into a dedicated shower space. This typically involves removing the bathtub, modifying plumbing as needed, and installing a new shower pan, walls, and fixtures. It's a popular remodeling project for homeowners seeking a more accessible bathroom or a modern aesthetic. The process can often be completed efficiently, minimizing disruption to your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: A tub-to-shower conversion remodels an existing tub and shower into a dedicated walk-in shower. It's common for accessibility or modernizing a bathroom.
